articles.title: Nvidia’s Board Is Weighing Jensen Huang’s Future After Second Affair Revelation
articles.summary: Things look dire for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, as his future at the company may be in jeopardy. Recently, it was revealed that Huang had been involved in an extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy, and this week, news broke that he'd been involved in a second affair with one of his…
body: According to The New York Times, the Nvidia board of directors is meeting to discuss the situation, just days after launching an independent investigation into him. After the affair was first exposed, Nvidia quickly issued a statement saying that none of the company's secrets, or US state secrets, had been compromised. Huang also issued a letter to Nvidia employees, apologizing to his wife and children.

With AI technology taking off in the last couple of years, Nvidia has become a major supplier of the crucial hardware components powering this boom. While the company is best known for its graphics cards, its fortunes have risen exponentially as it has focused more heavily on AI chips, with Huang becoming the face of the AI boom in the US. Huang is also Nvidia's founder, having started the company in 1993 and run its day-to-day operations for decades. With a 3.56% stake, he's also Nvidia's largest shareholder.
points: Things look dire for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, as his future at the company may be in jeopardy.

articles.title: Elon Musk Extends Cybertruck Production to 'Work Through' Order Backlog, Says There Must Be Room for 'Sentimentality'
articles.summary: Elon Musk has extended production of Cybertruck to work through an order backlog, the Tesla owner has said. Last week, the tech billionaire confirmed plans to wind down production of the Cybertruck at Tesla's gigafactory in Texas around the middle of next year to make room for increased Cybercab…
body: But Musk said today that production will now be extended through the end of summer 2027. He did not put a firm date on the end of production, but did provide some commentary around the decision, saying: “This is not the smartest move from a profit-maximizing standpoint btw, but there must be some room in this world for sentimentality or what’s the point?”

The angular Cybertruck launched in 2023 to much fanfare, but sales have been poor. Indeed, the truck has suffered online ridicule ever since it was introduced in 2019, when Musk himself shattered its supposed unbreakable glass during a live demo.

While fans of both Musk and Cybertruck have welcomed the news, there is no suggestion here that Tesla is making a long-term commitment to production of the vehicle. The focus, now, is on Cybercab, which Musk has said will play a crucial role in Tesla’s robotaxi plans. According to Reuters, the two-seater robotaxi is still a small program, with production beginning only earlier this year. Tesla has listed an installed capacity of more than 125,000 units.

articles.title: CD Projekt Red Will Use AI to Bring Back Geralt’s Original Voice
articles.summary: In 2019, Jacek Rozenek, the Polish voice actor for Geralt of Rivia in The Witcher games, suffered a stroke that greatly affected his speech. He underwent extensive training to recuperate and regain his ability to act. However, the changes in his voice were still noticeable.
body: If you played the English version of The Witcher 3, Doug Cockle will immediately spring to mind when you think of Geralt of Rivia. However, in the game's original version, Geralt is played by Jacek Rozenek, a renowned voice actor with 30 years of experience. CD Projekt has hired Rozenek to play Geralt of Rivia since the original The Witcher game in 2007, and the Polish studio wants him to continue in the role for Songs of the Past. Unfortunately, the actor suffered a stroke in 2019, that, according to Game File, left him unable to speak for months.

After extensive rehabilitation, Rozenek was able to speak again, but his voice was not the same. Stephen Totilo wrote, "it was lower, gruffer," after an interview with the actor. CDPR concluded that while this voice change might work well for an older Geralt in The Witcher 4, it wouldn't blend well with the voice you hear in The Witcher 3. Coming out next year, the Songs of the Past DLC is set in the same era as the main game, and the two are closely connected. This means that fans will hear newly recorded lines and older lines in close succession. To solve this problem, CDPR is working with AI voice cloning company Respeecher.

articles.title: Nvidia board considering ousting CEO Jensen Huang, report claims, as news of a second affair comes to light
articles.summary: Nvidia's board of directors has reportedly met to decide whether to remove the company's embattled CEO Jensen Huang, as news of a second extramarital affair has come to light.
body: Per the Wall Street Journal, the board met on Wednesday to decide whether to remove Huang following reports he allegedly participated in another affair with an executive who worked for him. This followed the revelation of his affair with an alleged Chinese spy, which prompted a company-wide apology from Huang and an independent investigation into whether he'd been the target of a "foreign intelligence effort".

The board's decision has yet to be made, but there are three expected outcomes. Either Huang stays with the company and continues as Nvidia leader, despite the controversy or he is replaced as CEO, or he quits. Nvidia's share price dropped following reports of this meeting taking place.

If Huang is fired - and perhaps even if he isn't - it's likely to severely disrupt Nvidia's operations. Huang co-founded Nvidia and led it to become one of the world's most valuable companies - it interchangeably wears that crown, alternating with Apple. Replacing Huang might change the company's focus.

articles.title: Amy Hennig's Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra hasn't been cancelled, Skydance reportedly says, as rumours swirl to the contrary
articles.summary: You'd be forgiven for forgetting that Amy Hennig's superhero game Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra exists, but apparently it's still in development despite its many troubles and rumours to the contrary.
body: Reassurance comes from Skydance's Slack work chat where, Kotaku says, executive producer Lu Gigliotti told the team they'd spoken "directly" with Skydance leadership and could reassure staff the game wasn't going to be cancelled. "They asked me to make sure you all hear that directly," Gigliotti reportedly told staff. "There is no truth to these claims."

This follows a recent rumour that the action adventure title was potentially going to get the axe in the near future. The rumour originated from a Marvel 1943 fan account, and while the original X post has since been deleted, it didn't stop it from spreading online, including amongst the game's own development staff.
According to Kotaku's report, Rise of Hydra is close to its alpha state, despite seemingly five years of development. The game is said to have had multiple issues through its long development.

articles.title: 7 Greatest Live-Service Games Killed Before Their Time, Ranked
articles.summary: At one point or another, most of us have enjoyed a live-service game. Likewise, many of us have been burned when a game publisher decided the revenue no longer justified the ongoing expenses of maintaining an always-on experience. Suddenly, we had nothing to show for our time except memories.
body: Plenty of games reach that point after giving off warning signs. Maybe they never got big enough to last. Maybe they became huge, but then they faded away rapidly as audiences lost interest. Some live-service games were killed before their time, however. They deserved better, and we’re here to remember them.

The extended Final Fantasy franchise has included a number of live-service games. Despite the brand recognition, those efforts haven’t always fared well, even when they should have. For me, Mobius Final Fantasy is the best example of unmet potential.

First launched in Japan on June 4, 2015, the game lasted just shy of five years in that region and less than four in North America. It was originally a mobile-only title, noteworthy in part because of the involvement of producer Yoshinori Kitase and scenario supervisor Kazushige Nojima. The two Final Fantasy veterans helped assemble a compelling new take on the classic original Final Fantasy, featuring Garland and blank-slate Warrior of Light characters, among others.
points: At one point or another, most of us have enjoyed a live-service game.
Likewise, many of us have been burned when a game publisher decided the revenue no longer justified the ongoing expenses of maintaining an always-on experience.
Suddenly, we had nothing to show for our time except memories.
Some live-service games were killed before their time, however.

articles.title: Nvidia stock price plunges amid second Jensen Huang affair allegation — the AI company could be set to lose hundreds of billions in value
articles.summary: With a Democratic midterm win, a mini AI crash in China, and Jensen Huang admitted to an affair this Sunday, Nvidia was already in a tight spot. Now, a second affair allegation has come out about Nvidia's CEO, and the AI company's share price has taken a hit as a result.
body: This reported second affair is said to be with another Nvidia exec, Kimberly Powell, and now the GPU company turned AI company is investigating whether or not it should oust the long-time CEO.
Naturally, that instability is worrisome to some investors, who appear to be signalling distrust towards the company in light of these scandals.

To put the stock dip into perspective, at close on Friday, Nvidia stock was worth $188.70 a share, a dip from a high of $239.24 on October 6. This morning, after-hours trading puts it at $161.88, as of the time of writing. We haven't seen a share price as low as this for Nvidia since well over a year ago, at the end of June 2025.

With this after-hours trading figure in mind, Nvidia's market cap (share price multiplied by outstanding shares) works out to around $3.93 trillion, which is just under half a trillion less than its market cap before the affair with Alice Huang came out (between $4.3 and $ 4.5 trillion).

articles.title: 10 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Penguins That Prove Gary Larson Is Unbeatable
articles.summary: Everybody agrees that penguins are funny. They walk funny. They sound funny. They all look like they’re wearing tiny little tuxedos. They’re birds, but they can’t fly — that’s very funny. They live in utterly ridiculous places, and they fall down all the time.
body: It almost seems as though nature designed penguins purely for our amusement, which is why these clownish creatures have been comedy staples forever, including in The Far Side.

While penguins weren’t a top-tier Gary Larson fixation like cows and dinosaurs were, they were a semi-recurring source of comedy in his daily comic strip, which ran from 1980 until 1995. And, because penguins are such funny little guys, here are the 10 best penguin-oriented Far Side comics.

Penguins are such ridiculous creatures that if your town was being terrorized by a giant one, it’d be more embarrassing than anything else. Even with other funny animals, I don’t think this is the case. Monkeys are funny, but King Kong is one of the greatest monsters ever. Goats are funny, but I’m pretty sure a giant goat head-butting buildings would be horrifying. A giant penguin, though? There’s just no way to take that threat seriously, especially since these creatures presumably have a complete inability to stomp.
Okay, hamsters are funny, and I’m pretty sure they’d be funny as giants, but still not funnier than penguins.

articles.title: Constantine Director 'Hopeful' for Sequel After DC Studios Shakeup
articles.summary: The director of Constantine, Francis Lawrence, opened up about the movie's long-awaited sequel now that DC Studios has had a changing of the guard.
body: James Gunn and Peter Safran are out at DC Studios in a sudden and unexpected move that has sparked no end of worry and speculation among fans. Gunn, for his part, cited a distaste for the “corporate” side of the job, but confirmed that projects already in motion, like Man of Tomorrow, are still a-go.

Fans aren’t the only ones scratching their heads about what might happen next. Francis Lawrence, the director of oodles of Hollywood blockbusters, is also in this boat — though he’s rather optimistic about the situation, as it means he might finally get the chance to make another Constantine film.

Speaking with Collider ahead of his next movie, The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, Lawrence clarified that he isn’t happy for anyone to lose their jobs, but admitted that he’s keen on the possibility of getting Constantine 2 off the ground now that things are changing at DC.

articles.title: Monster Hunter Outlanders Review
articles.summary: This mobile spin-off maintains the gameplay loop and visuals of its console counterparts, with the caveat of how progress gates push microtransactions.
body: My biggest surprise with Outlanders is how uncompromising the scope of its world feels, right in line with a big mainline Monster Hunter, supported by the fact that this game looks absolutely stunning, and runs like a dream. On an iPhone 14 Plus I was able to run the game on High settings with a stable 45fps, and almost zero slowdown, even during intense battles.

The actual act of exploring the world feels just as entrancing as in major Monster Hunters. Various options for constructing camps and equipment as you explore the world make both traversal and item gathering easier. Camps unlock fast travel points and places to rest, catapults send your adventurer flying on their glider at high speed, and resource collectors constantly soak up those valuable items you need.

articles.title: "One of those ways where you can use AI ethically": CDPR have modified Geralt's Polish voice in The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past with genAI, due to actor's stroke
articles.summary: CD Projekt Red have reportedly enlisted Ukrainian AI firm Respeecher to modify voice lines recorded for the Polish version of Geralt of Rivia in The Witcher 3 's upcoming Songs of the Past expansion.
body: Game File report that after suffering a stroke in 2019 and having to rehabilitate his speech, Rozenek was able to record some lines as Geralt for a quest in The Witcher 3's 2022 next-gen update, but that doing so left the actor "so exhausted". With next year's Songs of the Past expansion, CD Projekt Red were seemingly more concerned about making sure lines recorded by post-stroke Rozenek don't sound markedly different to those he recorded a decade ago for the base game and its existing expansions.

After a meeting between the two sides confirmed that Rozenek's voice had grown lower and gruffer due to some combination of the stroke and him simply getting older, the studio made the decision not to recast the actor, but instead let modify Respeecher modify his lines to make them sound closer to those original recordings. Rozenek reportedly gave his blessing for this to go ahead. "The point is that this voice should be as close as possible to my voice from 12 years ago," he told Game File. "I have great trust...for the creators of this game."

articles.title: Steam’s Growing Review Backlog Has Cost Another Game Its Launch Date
articles.summary: Steam's growing backlog for approving game builds appears to be getting worse, as yet another studio's game is stuck in the purgatory of the platform's review program.
body: "Unfortunately, we're stuck waiting for Steam to review and approve our launch build. We have been waiting for a few weeks now and sadly don't know when they will finally get around to it," Australia Did It publisher Mystic Forge wrote in an update. "We're hoping to be able to launch as soon as possible and will update all of you the second we get an update. We really appreciate all of your continued support and apologize for the situation. We can't wait for you to check out the final game and hope to be able to get it into your hands soon!"

Australia Did It co-developer and game designer Rami Ismail said the game was originally submitted on October 20, and a minor controller issue caused it to fail. That bug was fixed the same day, but since then, Ismail and Aesthecian Labs have been stuck waiting for Steam approval.

points: Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown's Initial D Update is now available!
Experience an immersive update featuring a new game mode 'Duel', built in the spirit of Initial D as you battle through the ranks!
Also arriving in this update is the ability to change rim size, 8 player groups, new camera and a wide array of bug fixes!
Season 7's mid-season update is live now, so see you on the streets!
